config.label: Absolute path to the RPG Maker MV project to edit (the folder with data/ and js/)
config.description: Absolute path to the RPG Maker MV project to edit (the folder with data/ and js/). The server starts without it; needed for real editing, or call set_project_path at runtime.

config.label: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint to enable analyze_image mode "ai" (e
config.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint to enable analyze_image mode "ai" (e.g. https://api.openai.com or http://localhost:11434). Unset = vision disabled; every other tool works offline.

config.label: Bearer token for the vision endpoint (only sent when set)
config.description: Bearer token for the vision endpoint (only sent when set).

config.description: Vision model name to request (e.g. gpt-4o, llava). Defaults to meta/llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct.
